jobs.title: Data engineer/consultant
jobs.location: Arrondissement of Mechelen, Flemish Region, Belgium
jobs.description:
We zijn op zoek naar een ervaren Data Engineer (minstens 4 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen Data Engineering) voor een gedreven jonge onderneming die bedrijven ondersteunt bij het halen van waarde uit hun data met begrijpbare en schaalbare AI-oplossingen. Ze combineren technologische consultancy met de ontwikkeling van eigen SaaS-producten zoals AI-tools voor data-analyse en automatisering.

Wie ben jij?
Je hebt minstens 4 jaar relevante werkervaring
en bij voorkeur ook een relevante academische achtergrond
(bijvoorbeeld een Master Handelsingenieur, Master Fysica, Master Burgerlijk Ingenieur, Master Computerwetenschappen,…)
Een sterke technische bagage waaronder SQL, Python, Cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP), Databricks, DWH
en méér
Je hebt ervaring met ETL-processen en datamodellering en je hebt affiniteit met data-analyse en business intelligence

Het aanbod?
Een snelgroeiende organisatie die inzet op kennisdeling en persoonlijke groei
Bovenop jouw salaris een volledig pakket aan voordelen waaronder een wagen en tankkaart (of mobiliteitsbudget), extra netto-vergoeding, hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering, GSM met abonnement enzovoort.
Een persoonlijk groeiplan met tal van opleidingsmogelijkheden
32 verlofdagen, glijdende uren en thuiswerk
Een hechte community waar je dagelijks kan leren van sterke data professionals
Een organisatie met korte lijnen en open/transparante communicatie
….

Associate

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

IT System Data Services, Data Infrastructure and Analytics, and IT Services and IT Consulting

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are :

We are Qover, a leading insurtech scale-up that has raised $100 million. With an international team of 160+ colleagues based in Brussels and beyond, we help companies orchestrate digital embedded insurance experiences — creating meaningful connections with their community and enabling their success.
Since Qover was founded in 2016, our co-founders have had a clear vision of the future of insurance: it must be simple, transparent, and accessible across borders — a global safety net.
Our platform protects 15M+ users across 32 European countries and works with longstanding partners like Revolut, Mastercard, BMW, Canyon, and Monzo, among many others.

Visit our website for more about what we do!

About the role

In the Qover data team, we are engineers at heart with a strong focus on operations. We are supporting the executions of our insurance programs on a daily basis by ensuring that all our partners have access to fresh and reliable data.
We are seeking a mid/senior data engineer to strengthen our data capabilities. You will be in the driver's seat for implementing data reports, from prototyping to production, while always ensuring that your technical solutions align with the best engineering practices.
Our data stack (high-level): airbyte - bigquery - opencode - dbt - python - Looker

Your tasks and responsibilities

Your main objective is to develop and maintain scalable and clean data financial reports
to support the launch and execution of our insurance programs. We expect you to:
develop, maintain and improve our dbt
data pipelines that support the day-to-day operations of our embedded insurance programs
propose and implement a robust data model
that can cope with the specificities of insurance data and require little modification to support the launch of the new products
make sure that the data is delivered timely to our partners
run quality assurance checks to ensure data consistency across data deliverables
leverage synergies across our data sources to limit the number of tables in our BigQuery data warehouse
, and avoid that our databases turn into a data maze
Further develop our data governance through
extensive testing ( data tests, unit tests, anomaly detection)
sufficient data documentation
controlled data access
clear data lineage
make sure that our partners' data stay secure and private, one of our top priorities
In addition, you will be a key technical contributor to the data space at Qover. You will leverage your expertise on various topics to:
Push our data architecture to the next level. This includes a constant review of our data model and data warehouse design.
Upskill the team by evangelizing good practices through code reviews and dedicated sessions
Educate and help business users to become data-savvy

Your qualifications:

At least 3 years of experience in SQL and data modelling
Master's degree in STEM is preferred but not a hard requirement
Leverage AI agents to speed-up code development, testing and delivery
Experience in dbt is highly desirable
Fluent in python
You are familiar with the modern data stack
Experience with git, bash, CI/CD and docker
You have already delivered software products with unit and integration tests
You have experience working with cloud services, and more specifically with serverless data warehouses.
Excellent communication and presentation skills and fluent in English
Proficiency in Dutch is a plus
While you always want to keep up with market trends and best practices, you are also pragmatic. You feel comfortable trading technical elegance to be able to speed up the pace of delivery
Willing to work in fast-paced environment and able to cope with time pressure
Autonomous, you are also hands-on with a strong team spirit
You are proactive and self-driven. You need minimal supervision and welcome changes. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity.

What’s in it for you:

A flexible work environment: up to three days remote per week and the ability to work from anywhere one month per year
28 days off (8 extra days on top of the 20 legal days)
A nice working space in a great location in Brussels: Qover-dedicated space at WeWork (Rue du Commerce 31) with a large terrace to enjoy team events
A positive company culture that values teamwork and taking initiative but also having fun, with regular social events
A collaborative and communal environment where everyone is welcomed, valued and accepted regardless of their nationality, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, philosophical or political views, etc.
The chance to work among entrepreneurial people, giving you the opportunity to learn and have a real impact at one of Europe’s fastest-growing insurtechs

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Insurance and Financial Services
